onboarding.description: Name your organization to get started. You'll be its owner.

marketing.description: One platform for inbox, broadcast, and reporting for your LINE OA.

orgMembers.description: Manage members and roles in this organization.

orgMembers.removeConfirm: Remove this member from the organization?

orgMembers.inviteSent: No account exists for that email yet — an invite was sent. They'll join this organization automatically once they confirm it and set a password.
orgMembers.lastOwnerError: You can't remove or change the role of the organization's last owner.

broadcast.description: Send a message to your LINE OA's followers.

richMenu.description: Build the image menu shown in your LINE OA's chat.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: What each role can access in this organization.
roles.roleOwnerDescription: Manages everything, including the Admin Panel (users, LINE channels, audit log).
roles.roleAgentDescription: Full access to the User App (Inbox, Broadcast, Rich Menu, Reports), but no Admin Panel access.
roles.roleAnalystDescription: Same User App access as Agent — no Admin Panel access.
roles.agentAnalystNote: Note: Agent and Analyst currently have identical permissions in the User App — a read-only distinction for Analyst isn't implemented yet.

billing.title: Billing
billing.description: Manage this organization's plan and payment.
